description: This PHP file defines the LanguageService class within the OrangeHRM system. The class provides services related to language entities, including creating, retrieving, updating, deleting, and checking existence of language records. It acts as a business logic layer that interacts with the LanguageDao data access object to perform database operations.

classes.name: LanguageService
classes.description: A service class providing business logic for managing language entities in the OrangeHRM system, interfacing with the LanguageDao for database operations.

methods.name: getLanguageDao
methods.description: Initializes the LanguageDao if not already set and returns it.

methods.name: setLanguageDao
methods.description: Sets the LanguageDao instance used by the service.

methods.name: saveLanguage
methods.description: Saves a language entity, either creating a new record or updating an existing one.

methods.name: getLanguageById
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its ID.

methods.name: getLanguageByName
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its name, case-insensitive.

methods.name: getLanguageCount
methods.description: Returns the count of languages matching search filter parameters.

methods.name: getLanguageList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of languages based on search filter parameters, ordered by name.

methods.name: isExistingLanguageName
methods.description: Checks if a language name already exists in the system, case-insensitive.
